limitations: not controlled for EP3 topology, migration actor, behaviour, funding/fanout, 3SW2 truth, or contrast subclasses
promotion_gate: separate authorization required for all-42664 discovery

role.eligibility: every unique member of the authoritative frozen population
role.name: neutral_validation_sample

selection.deduplication: one row per mint; duplicate mint in manifest is HOLD_P3R_S2B_REDUCED_SELECTION_CONTRACT_MISMATCH
selection.digest: SHA-256 of newline-delimited canonical JSON rows including ordinal, role, mint, create_creator, population_ordinal, and population SHA
selection.ordering: mint ASC, then create_creator ASC, then population_ordinal ASC

validation_objectives.association_clustering: PASS only if frozen method replay is equal and ambiguities follow frozen rules
validation_objectives.bounded_resources: PASS if frozen bound completes; HOLD otherwise
validation_objectives.deterministic_discovery_outputs: PASS if frozen method replay is equal; HOLD otherwise
validation_objectives.deterministic_evidence_processing: PASS if two evaluation executions are byte/canonical-output equal; HOLD otherwise
validation_objectives.fail_closed: PASS if injected/observed contract failure terminates without promotion; HOLD otherwise
validation_objectives.provenance_audit: PASS if all inputs/outputs/digests are recorded; HOLD otherwise
